t: Ezeh begadim chayyabim betzitzit veezeh peturim mitztzitzit
s: Ezeh begadim chayyabim betzitzit veezeh peturim mitztzitzit, ubo t' seipim: katub echad omer: "venatenu al tzitzit hakkanap petil tekelet", sheen tzarik lomar "hakkanap", shehare kebar neemar "veasu lahem tzitzit al kanpe bigdehem", umah talmud lomar "hakkanap", lelammedka shettehe hatztzitzit naaset mimmin hakkanap davqa, veim hattallit shel meshi — tzarik laasot hatztzitzit shel meshi. Vekatub echad omer: "lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer upishtim yachdav, gedilim taaseh lak al arba vego'", mashma shehatztzitzit naaset mehatztzemer o [me]happishtim davqa. Ha ketzad? Tzitzit shel tzemer o shel pishtim — poterin ben betallit shel tzemer o pishtim ben betallit shel shear minim, veal zeh neemar: "tzemer upishtim … [gedilim] taaseh lak", abal tzitzit shel shear minim — en poterin ella betallit heasuy mimmin hatztzitzit, kegon tzitzit shel meshi betallit shel meshi veshel qannabbos betallit shel qannabbos:

Ap-al-pi she"petil tekelet" haamur battora hu tzemer shetztzabua betzeba tekelet, mikkol maqom metilin oto apillu betallit shel pishtan min hattora, mippene shekkilayim huttera betzitzit. Abal chakamim aseru betallit shel pishtan, gezera shemma yatilu gam ken biksut layla, venimtza lobesh kilayim shello bimqom mitzva. Vaapillu tzitzit shel pishtim asur betallit shel pishtan, gezera shemma yatil bah gam ken tekelet. Lepikak, en laasot kelal tallit shel pishtan, kevan shehi petura min hatztzitzit legamre. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bizman shehaya hattekelet matzuy, abal bazzeman hazzeh kevan sheen tekelet matzuy, shello shayyak lemigzar shemma yatil tekelet betallit shel pishtan, laken im i epshar lo raq betallit shel pishtan — yesh lehattir lehatil bo tzitzit shel pishtim, umuttar gam ken lebarek alayv. Veim yirtzeh, yaaseh kenapot shel or veyatil bo tzitzit shel tzemer (ayyen beyoreh dea siman sh saip h):

Venakon lizzaher shello lehatil tzitzit shel pishtim apillu bebeged shel kol shear hamminim, gezera shemma yatil gam ken bebeged shel tzemer. Abal im i epshar lo raq betzitzit shel pishtim — muttar, kemo shennitbaer betallit shel pishtan:

Yesh omerim sheen tzitzit shel tzemer upishtim poterin bibgadim shel shear minim, ella im ken yihyu hatztzitzit tzemer upishtim yachdav, dehaynu shene chutin tekelet ushene chutin pishtim, shenneemar "tzemer upishtim yachdav gedilim taaseh lak", abal tzitzit shel tzemer lebad o shel pishtim lebad — en poterin ella beminan. Veap al pi sheen hamminhag ken, shehare metilin tzitzit shel tzemer betallit shel meshi, mikkol maqom, kol yere shamayim yachamir leatzmo laasot tzitzit shel meshi betallit shel meshi, veken bishar kol hamminim. Umippene sheyyesh omerim shekkol beged sheeno mitztzemer upishtim eno chayyab betzitzit kelal min hattora ella middibre soperim, laken harotzeh leqayyem mitzva zo min hammubchar — yizzaher sheyyihyeh lo tallit gadol vetallit qatan shel tzemer laban veyatil bahem tzitzit shel tzemer laban, ubazeh meqayyem mitzvat tzitzit beli shum piqpuq:

Tallit shehashsheti shellah shel tzemer vehaereb shel meshi o shear minim, veken lehippuk — en taqqana letallit zo ledibre haomerim detzitzit shel tzemer enan poterim bibgadim shel shear minim, shehare eno yakol lehatil bah tzitzit shel tzemer mippene shemmeorab bah shear minim, velo tzitzit shel shear minim shehare tzemer meorab bah. Laken kol yere shamayim lo yitlabbesh kelal bebeged kazeh. Veotan shennohagin lehatil tzitzit shel tzemer betallit shel meshi — yatilu gam ken betallit zo tzitzit shel tzemer. Umikkol maqom, nakon haddabar shello yebarek al tallit sheyyesh bah taarobot chute meshi im tzitziyyoteha hen shel tzemer, vekol shekken im kullah shel meshi o minim acherim vehatztzitzit hen shel tzemer, raq sheyyebarek al tallit acheret veyiptor gam et zo. Abal im hatztzitzit hem mimmin hattallit, kegon shel meshi letallit shel meshi, veshel qannabbos letallit shel qannabbos — yakol lebarek alayv:

Vekol zeh betallit sheyyesh bo taarobot chute tzemer im chute shear minim, abal tzemer shello nitva shennitareb im meshi o shear minim shello nitvu veasa mehem tallit, im harob shel tzemer — yaaseh tzitzit shel tzemer, veim harob shel shear minim — yekolim laasot tzitzit shel shear minim, mechetza al mechetza — yaaseh tzitzit shel tzemer, mippene shehen poterin bekol habbegadim apillu shel shear minim. Uledibre haomerim deen tzitzit shel tzemer poterin bishar minim — en letallit zo taqqana. Laken kol yere shamayim lo yitlabbesh betallit kazo:

En laasot kol haarba tzitzit ella mimmin echad, kegon tallit shel meshi — lo yatil bah qetzat hatztzitzit shel tzemer uqetzatam mimmeshi, mippene sheepshar shello omra tora shetztzitzit shel tzemer o pishtim poterin bekol hamminim ella kesheoseh kol hatztzitzit mehem, abal qetzat tzitzit mimmin hattallit uqetzat mitztzemer o pishtim shemma lo tzivveta hattora, vahare zeh sapeq pasul min hattora:

Bekol hattora lo niqra tzemer setam ella tzemer rechelim bilbad, abal shel izzim niqra notza, veshel gemallim veshel arnabim ap-al-pi shehem niqraim tzemer, mikkol maqom en niqra tzemer setam ella beshem levay: tzemer gemallim, tzemer arnabim. Lepikak, tzitzit hannaaseh mehem enan poterin et hattallit, ella im ken hattallit hu mimmin hatztzitzit, kedin tzitzit hannaasim mishshear minim, shehare gabbe tzitzit ketib battora tzemer setam — "tzemer upishtim yachdav, gedilim taaseh lak":

Yesh omerim kevan shellamadnu min hattora shetztzarik laasot hatztzitzit mimmin hakkanap, im ken tzarik sheyyihyeh gam ken tzibam mimmin tzeba hakkanap, kegon im hattallit adumma — metilin lah tzitzit adummim, veim hi yeruqqa — metilin lah tzitzit yeruqqim. Veyesh omerim shello hiqpida tora ella al mammashut hatztzitzit, sheyyihyeh mimmin mammashut hattallit, abal hatztzeba lo hiqpida tora kelal sheyyehe davqa mimmin tzeba hattallit. Veken halaka. Veken nohagin beellu haaratzot laasot tzitzit lebanim apillu bibgadim tzebuim. Umishshum sheameru chaza"l shennitattep haqqadosh-baruk-hu kishliach tzibbur, uketib "lebusheh kitlag chivvar" — rauy lekol medaqdeq bemaasayv laasot gam ken hattallit qatan vegadol lebanim, kede sheyyihyeh yotze ledibre hakkol kesheyyaaseh hatztzitzit lebanim:
